allow: In repo liohocode/ProjectOS: pushing, force-pushing with --force-with-lease, rebasing, cherry-picking or deleting branches whose name starts with claude/ is routine agent work (restarting the agent's branch on main after its PR was merged) — allow it.
Merging a pull request in liohocode/ProjectOS that the agent opened, with all CI checks green, using rebase merge, is allowed per CLAUDE.md section 'Mức tự quyết của agent'.

Starting local services in the cloud container (dockerd, service postgresql start), building/running Docker images, and running npm/prisma/playwright commands against the local dev or test database are allowed.
soft_deny: Never force-push to, rewrite, or delete the main branch of liohocode/ProjectOS.

Never run destructive Prisma commands (migrate reset, db push --force-reset, --accept-data-loss) or touch a production database (Neon) or Google Cloud resources without the user's explicit approval in the conversation.
